header.name: Dr. Sanket Salvi
header.title: Assistant Professor (Level 11), MIT-WPU · Ph.D. (IT, NIT Karnataka) · IoT / Li-Fi / AI / Full-Stack

summary.text: Academician and technologist with 12 years spanning teaching and research (6 + 6). Ph.D. in Information Technology (NIT Karnataka), specializing in Visible Light Communication (Li-Fi) for indoor IoT. Work spans IoT systems, AI/ML, computer vision, AR/VR & digital twins, healthcare informatics, and full-stack development. 47+ peer-reviewed publications, 6 patents, and multiple best-paper and best-project awards.
